name: invidious
description: Invidious is an alternative front-end to YouTube
one_liner: A stripped-down, ad-free way to watch YouTube videos without an account, ads, or tracking.
buyer: Honestly, mostly privacy-conscious hobbyists who self-host it for personal use — there isn't a clean paying business buyer here.
business_use_cases: A privacy-focused individual self-hosts it to watch YouTube without ads or a Google account.
A digital-rights nonprofit points members to a public instance as part of a 'de-Google your life' guide.

money_ideas.idea: Accept donations to run a public instance for the privacy community.

steal_this: Not really a business starter kit — it exists to remove monetization, and reselling access likely violates YouTube's terms of service, so there's no honest weekend business here.
